raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

MiMo-V2.5-Pro defines a per-model `attention_value_scale` that the attention forward applies to V before writing the KV cache and before the attention output (`v = v * v_scale`). On NPU this materializes as an extra `aclnnMuls` kernel per layer in every decode/verify step — ~2 ms/layer on MiMo-V2.5-Pro EP6 profiling (~8% of the attention section).

Attention is linear in V:

    softmax(qk) @ (s · V) ≡ s · (softmax(qk) @ V)

so multiplying the layer's `o_proj.weight` by `s` at load time reproduces the runtime `v * v_scale` exactly, and the per-token kernel disappears.

## Modifications

- Add `MiMoV2ForCausalLM._fold_attention_value_scale_into_o_proj`, called at the end of `load_weights`: for each attention layer with a `v_scale`, multiply `o_proj.weight.data` by `attention_value_scale` (when the config defines one) and clear `attn.v_scale` so the runtime multiply is skipped.
- Only floating-point o_proj weights are folded (MiMo FP4 checkpoints keep o_proj in bf16, so this covers the shipped configurations); a quantized o_proj keeps the runtime multiply and logs a warning.
- The KV cache now stores unscaled V. This stays self-consistent because every consumer of V (decode, target-verify, DFlash draft KV materialization) goes through the same layer's (folded) o_proj.
- MTP draft (`mimo_v2_nextn.py`) and DFlash draft (`dflash.py`) have independent weight loading and their own v_scale handling; they are unaffected.

## Accuracy Tests

```
echo performance | tee /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu*/cpufreq/scaling_governor
sysctl -w vm.swappiness=0
sysctl -w kernel.numa_balancing=0
sysctl -w kernel.sched_migration_cost_ns=50000
export SGLANG_SET_CPU_AFFINITY=1

source /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh
source /usr/local/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh

export HCCL_BUFFSIZE=300
export HCCL_OP_EXPANSION_MODE=AIV
export PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
export STREAMS_PER_DEVICE=32
export SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_BOOTSTRAP_TIMEOUT=600
export SGLANG_ENABLE_SPEC_V2=1
export SGLANG_ENABLE_OVERLAP_PLAN_STREAM=1
export ASCEND_USE_FIA=1
export SGLANG_DEEPEP_NUM_MAX_DISPATCH_TOKENS_PER_RANK=32
export DEEPEP_HCCL_BUFFSIZE=2500
export DEEPEP_NORMAL_LONG_SEQ_ROUND=20
export DEEPEP_NORMAL_LONG_SEQ_PER_ROUND_TOKENS=4096
export HCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=lo
export GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME=lo
export HCCL_HOST_SOCKET_PORT_RANGE=auto
export SGLANG_ALLOW_OVERWRITE_LONGER_CONTEXT_LEN=1

sglang serve \
        --model-path $MODEL_PATH \
        --served-model-name $MODEL_PATH \
        --trust-remote-code \
        --attention-backend ascend \
        --device npu \
        --mem-fraction-static 0.92 \
        --tp-size 8 --nnodes 1 --node-rank 0 \
        --chunked-prefill-size 8192 --max-total-tokens 600000 \
        --max-running-requests 32 \
        --moe-a2a-backend deepep --deepep-mode auto \
        --cuda-graph-bs-decode 1 2 4 8 16 \
        --speculative-algorithm DFLASH \
        --speculative-draft-model-path $DFLASH_PATH \
        --speculative-num-draft-tokens 8 \
        --dp-size 2 --enable-dp-attention --enable-dp-lm-head \
```


## Speed Tests and Profiling

MiMo-V2.5-Pro, NPU, EP6 decode profiling: the per-layer `aclnnMuls` multiplier is eliminated (~2 ms/layer, ~8% of the attention section in the profiled window). No new kernels are introduced; the fold is a one-time load-time weight transform.

- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).
